summary: Cards no longer lose their path label. When the concepts the reader can read now have no unshown papers left, build_batch used to drop the path picks and return an ordinary batch (no label, and the reason was never shown). It now keeps the exploration papers with their tag and fills the rest by the ordinary ranking, labelled 'offroute' (with the concept the paper resembles, if any); the Today panel says why and what to do (fetch new papers). The exploration tag is now a solid bold tag with a mark, and exploration cards get a left bar.

budget_impact.rationale: Local ranking and labels only; no model call, no network, no new stored data (the kind goes into the existing exposures route columns).
budget_impact.before: an ordinary unlabelled batch when the path ran out of papers
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.command: browser preview of the Today page on a scratch copy with synthetic cards
additional_checks.scope: the exploration tag, the off-path label and a normal path label side by side

open_risks: How often the path runs out on the owner's real library is unknown.
A batch of off-path fillers is ordinary ranking under a label; it does not fetch new papers by itself.
The Tauri window was not clicked through.
